dataset_metadata.name: Battery test data - fast formation study
dataset_metadata.citation: Weng, A., Mohtat, P., Attia, P., Less, G., Lee, S., Stefanopoulou, A. (2021). Battery test data - fast formation study [Data set], University of Michigan - Deep Blue Data. https://doi.org/10.7302/pa3f-4w30
dataset_metadata.funding: National Science Foundation (NSF), grant number 176224; University of Michigan Battery Laboratory

cell_info.electrolyte: 1.0 M LiPF6 in 3:7 EC:EMC v/v + 2 wt% VC
cell_info.cell_notes: Custom-built pouch cells assembled at the University of Michigan Battery Laboratory. Cathode: 94:3:3 NMC111 (TODA North America) / C65 / PVDF (Kureha 7208), double-sided loading 34.45 mg/cm2. Anode: 97:0:1.5/1.5 graphite (Hitachi MAG-E3) / CMC / SBR (Zeon BM-451B), double-sided loading 15.7 mg/cm2. 7 cathodes and 8 anodes, z-fold stacked. Total cell mass 56.6 +/- 0.3 g. Gravimetric and volumetric values are stack-level estimates.

aging_modes.notes: Two formation protocols (fast formation ~14 h; baseline formation ~56 h) crossed with two cycling temperatures (room temperature and 45 deg C), giving 4 groups of ~10 cells each. One cell (baseline formation, 45 deg C group) was excluded due to tab weld issues, reducing that group to 9. EOL for the cycle life test was defined as discharge capacity < 1.18 Ah (50% of 2.36 Ah nominal). The 70% threshold was used as an analysis milestone in the paper but cells were cycled to 50%.

time_protocol.test_equipment: Maccor Series 4000 cycler (0-5 V, 10 A, auto-ranging)
time_protocol.notes: Total test time varied between 3 to 4 months; total cycles achieved ranged between 400 and 600. Formation cycling also conducted on Maccor Series 4000 (0-5 V, 30 uA - 1 A, auto-ranging). Room temperature group experienced varying ambient temperatures throughout the day (24.5 +/- 0.6 deg C); 45 deg C group held in thermal chamber (Espec) at 44.2 +/- 0.1 deg C.

rawdata.data_quality_notes: Raw timeseries files exported via Voltaiq software. Covers formation cycling and aging cycles for all cells. Post-processed output files also included.
rawdata.known_issues: One cell (#9, baseline formation group) excluded from study due to tab weld issues.

checkup.notes: RPT inserted every 50 to 100 cycles. RPT consists of: (1) C/3 charge-discharge cycle, (2) C/20 charge-discharge cycle (pseudo-OCV), (3) HPPC sequence to extract 10-s DC resistance (R10s) as a function of SOC. RPT performed at the same temperature as the cycling test.

notes: This dataset investigates the impact of two formation protocols (fast formation ~14 h vs. baseline formation ~56 h) on NMC111/graphite custom pouch cell lifetime. The fast formation protocol charges the cell rapidly to 3.9 V at 1C then cycles between 3.9 and 4.2 V at C/5 before a final C/10 discharge; the baseline protocol uses three C/10 charge-discharge cycles between 3.0 and 4.2 V. All formation was conducted at room temperature. Post-formation, cells were cycle-aged at room temperature or 45 deg C using symmetric 1C/1C cycling (3.0-4.2 V). A key finding is that a low-SOC resistance signal (R_LS, measured at 5% SOC via HPPC) measured immediately after formation is a strong predictor of cycle life. Data and source code are deposited at University of Michigan Deep Blue Data (DOI: 10.7302/pa3f-4w30); source code also available at Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.5525258).
